title: Deccal Şu An Nerede? Hadiste Anlatılan Esrarengiz Ada
lessons: Eliminate preamble entirely and start the main narrative hook within the first 5 seconds to prevent early viewer drop-off.
Cut repetitive background descriptions during the first minute to maintain high momentum and avoid frustrating viewers.
Insert a secondary mini-hook or visual shift at the 1:20 mark to re-engage viewers before the initial tension fades.

title: Ahit Sandığı Nerede: Kuruyan Gölün Dibinde Ne Bulundu?
lessons: Start the video immediately with the core mystery at 0:00 without delay to prevent the steep 12 percent drop at 0:34.
Eliminate slow historical descriptions around 3:34 by merging background details with active narrative stakes to retain viewers.
Keep the intro under 30 seconds since 34 percent of the audience leaves before the main title segment begins.
